name: Our Skyy 2: My School President
original_name: Our Skyy 2 แฟนผมเป็นประธานนักเรียน
overview: In the world we know, Gun and Tinn are an established couple. In this universe, however, their love story has only just begun. Gun is an exemplary student body president. Tinn is the mischievous leader of the music club hoping to win the Hot Sound music contest.
